title: US Market Indexes Close Higher on the Last Day of October
text:

Bookmark of this page has been deleted. US Market Indexes Close Higher on the Last Day of October Nasdaq Composite closes at 7,305.90 for a gain of 2.01% October 31, 2018 | About: V +0% CAT +0% MSFT +0% GS +0% AAPL +0% GM +0%
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed at 25,115.76 on Wednesday with a gain of 241.12 points or 0.97%. The S&P 500 closed at 2,711.74 for a gain of 29.11 points or 1.09%. The Nasdaq Composite closed at 7,305.90 for a gain of 144.25 points or 2.01%. The VIX Volatility Index was lower at 21.04 for a loss of -2.31 points or -9.89%.
Wednesday’s market movers
Stocks ended with a gain on the last trading day of a brutal October. Closing out the month, the S&P 500 was down -7.3%, the Dow Jones had a loss of -5.8% and the Nasdaq Composite was down -9.1%.
U.S. market indexes reported their second day of consecutive gains on Wednesday with the trade battle between the U.S. and China likely to be an important factor influencing the market’s direction in the last two months of the year. Earnings helped to contribute to the day’s gains. Automaker General Motors ( NYSE:GM ) topped the earnings list with a 61 cent earnings per share beat and share price increase of 9.51%.
